fast.label: Fast
fast.hint: Slow effects buy your towers time (Snowchaser, Frost Dryad).

tank.label: Tank
tank.hint: Burst single-target chews through big HP pools (Caster, Kaido Assassin).

armored.label: Armored
armored.hint: Arcane / spirit / frost cuts through armor; strike is heavily reduced.

regen.label: Regen
regen.hint: Bursts kill before they heal back; slow trickle damage gets out-healed.

shielded.label: Shielded
shielded.hint: Fast multi-hit eats shields (Archer, Azurite Lion). Single big hits waste.

boss.label: BOSS
boss.hint: Focus the boss with single-target casters; deal with adds via splash.

splitter.label: Splitter
splitter.hint: Splits into smaller enemies on death. Splash damage cleans the brood; otherwise a single-target tower kills the mother and then has to deal with all the children.

silence.label: Silence
silence.hint: Towers periodically stop firing for ~1.5s. Front-load damage between silences; fast multi-hit recovers faster than slow-rate burst casters.

corruption.label: Corruption
corruption.hint: Every leak corrupts a tile near the core; towers on corrupted tiles fire at 70% rate. Don't leak. If you do, sell from the corrupted tile.
